task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

excluded_cohorts: From Published Evidence to Analyzable Biomedical Cohorts

model.name: Transported linear-location cohort with bounded physiological support
model.interpretation: An explicitly assumed equal-weight representation of the declared analytical population, not an identified reconstruction of that population.

error_law.family: Centered bivariate Student t with covariance specified below
error_law.covariance_definition: D @ (Ryy - Ryx @ inverse(Rxx) @ Ryx.T) @ D, where D=diag(anchor_outcome_sd)
error_law.sampling_definition: If L L.T equals this covariance, error=(L z)*sqrt((df-2)/chi_square(df)), with independent standard-normal z and chi-square draw.

bp.support_algorithm: Hold each person's covariates fixed and redraw paired errors until both BP values and their difference satisfy all support constraints. This defines a covariate-specific truncated conditional law, not clipping or sample-wide calibration.
